image:image.image:title: Install from the Microsoft Store
image:image.image:caption: Get the app free from the Store, or open the Store on your Windows PC and search for "PyFy Telemetry". Click "Get" to download. No account or cloud services, no ads or in-app purchases, no data collec

image:image.image:title: Installation Complete
image:image.image:caption: Once installed, click Open to launch the app for the first time.

image:image.image:title: First Start
image:image.image:caption: On first launch, the app creates a default configuration and starts listening for in-game telemetry right away. Optional: change ports and capture options or add a Desktop shortcut in Listener setting

image:image.image:title: F1 25 - Telemetry Settings
image:image.image:caption: Then, confirm/adjust your game settings. In F1 25, go to Settings and select "Telemetry Settings".

image:image.image:title: F1 25 - UDP Telemetry Configuration
image:image.image:caption: Set UDP Telemetry to On, Send rate to 60Hz, and the UDP Port to match the app's listen port (20774 by default). Set UDP Format to 2026 if you've purchased the DLC, or 2025 otherwise. IP Address remain

image:image.image:title: Ready to Start
image:image.image:caption: That's it, the one-time setup is complete. Start a new race or session in the F1 game to capture your first session: see demo. Optional: change ports in Listener settings.

image:image.image:title: SimPro Manager (Optional)
image:image.image:caption: If you use Simagic SimPro Manager, or other sim racing software, set its own UDP Listen Port to match the app's forwarding port (20775).

image:image.image:title: Listener Settings (Optional)
image:image.image:caption: Defaults should work out-of-the-box. To change them, open "Telemetry & Settings > Listener settings" in the app. It is recommended to keep "Enable raw telemetry capture" on.

image:image.image:title: Console Setup - Install the App
image:image.image:caption: Playing on console? First, install the app on a separate Windows device (e.g. on a laptop). See how in PC setup. Then, tweak the Listener settings to enable console support.

image:image.image:title: Console Setup - App Settings
image:image.image:caption: In "Telemetry & Settings > Listener settings", enable [Advanced] Allow broadcast IP - this lets the app receive telemetry from your console. You'll be prompted to allow a Windows Firewall exception.

image:image.image:title: Console Setup - Game Settings
image:image.image:caption: Finally, in F1 25 Telemetry Settings, set UDP Broadcast Mode to On. This broadcasts telemetry to all devices on your local network, including the Windows device running the app. All other settings rem

image:image.image:title: Live Capture
image:image.image:caption: Start the app. Then, start your F1 25 race. The companion app runs in the background; it automatically detects sessions and records telemetry.

image:image.image:title: Session Complete
image:image.image:caption: After the race, the "Latest Race: Charts & Analysis" quick action will be displayed. Use that to browse through a reel of selected charts that show exactly where and how you can improve your lap times

image:image.image:title: Analysis Charts - Coaching Insights
